notes.title: May 13th Update Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Collision improvements
[*] Made rounds start earlier (not just checked every ten seconds)
[*] You now have to beat round 5 of Dunce Island before unlocking Outside 1
[*] Added Item Descriptions in Hub
[*] Increased Boons gained from 2 to 3
[*] Increased odds of Byproduct Boons unlocked
[*] Lowered rounds reached requirements for major doors
[*] Increased initial ammo count
[*] Increased Eggs gained in levels
[*] Decreased overall enemy health 
[*] Decreased critter speed
[*] Lowered enemy resistance duration
[*] Added audio queue to incoming projectiles
[*] Reduced enemy teleportation distance
[*] Reduced price of the crane in Hammy's
[/list]
